stubs.label: synthetic context callback boundary; literal raw return

scope: Conditional scalar context dispatch/check; synthetic descriptor and literal callback return.
limitations: No actual context initialization/callback identity or interrupt semantics is established. Prefixes stop before BKPT and do not execute it; the recorder seeds incoming LR with the selected stop.

manager release

scope: Conditional manager request with real dependency/check/context dispatcher and literal enable/context replies. Nonzero-context prefix stops before BKPT; zero-context case executes the full manager return.
limitations: Synthetic object/table/reply state does not establish live initialization, actual context callback identity, synchronization, error enums or hardware effects. Prefix incoming LR is the internal stop; frames are actual but not natural caller frames.
